transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... I guess I just keep getting these flashes. They kind of hit me out of nowhere. I'll be at work, just standing at a pickup counter, and... suddenly it's like I'm back in that crowded holding room. Just... seeing the fight again. Hearing everybody get shoved to the wall. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
How long have you been experiencing these flashbacks? Have they been happening for more than a month?
No... not a month. Just about a week. Ever since I... got detained overnight. That's when I saw that assault happen in the holding area. So, yeah. Just a week.
Since the incident, have you been avoiding places, people, or activities that remind you of what happened?

Yeah... I guess so. I've been, um... turning down night runs for work. Taking the long way around town. I just... I can't make myself go anywhere near that detention building. And... I don't really want to talk about what happened, either. If I do, it just... it feels like I'm right back there.
Since this happened, have you been feeling more on edge, fearful, or upset most of the time?
I guess... yeah. Just... tense, I suppose. Not really sleeping great. Just... waiting for something to happen, maybe. I don't know. It's just... hard to relax.
Since this happened, have you noticed any changes in the way you feel or think about yourself or the world — like feeling guilty, blaming yourself, or thinking that the world is dangerous?
I don't... I don't think so. I just... I don't really think about it like that. I just want to forget it.
Since this happened, have you found yourself feeling angry, sad, or fearful more often than usual?
Not really... I don't know. I'm not angry or... sad, I don't think. I just... I try to keep my head down and do my job. I'm not really focusing on all that.
Have you had any moments where you feel overwhelmed by fear, sadness, or anger since this happened?
No, not really overwhelmed. I just... I don't really get like that. I just try to keep moving, you know? Not dwell on it.
Since this happened, have you felt any ongoing fear, sadness, or anger, even if it's not overwhelming?
No... I mean, I really don't think so. Like I said, I'm just... I'm just trying to get through my routes and go home. I don't really feel... any of that.
Since this happened, have you had any days where you feel fear, sadness, or anger that just doesn't seem to go away, even if it's not intense?
I don't... no. I haven't really noticed anything like that. I just... I don't think I'm feeling that way. I'm just tired, I guess.
Since this happened, have you had any days where you feel fear, sadness, or anger that just doesn't seem to go away, even if it's not intense?
I... didn't you just ask me that? The answer is still no. I really don't feel like that.
Since this happened, have you noticed any loss of interest in things you usually enjoy, or found yourself feeling emotionally numb?
No, not really. I still do the same things I always do. I don't... I wouldn't say I'm numb. I'm just doing what I have to do.
